meta.title: Siaya County: 30 county assembly ward boundaries (simplified for display)
meta.attribution: Ward boundaries: American Red Cross via HDX, CC BY, 2016
meta.source_caveat: Data abstracted from different sources including National Land Commission/IEBC & SOK then cleaned for topological errors and verified with county teams from > 20 counties. Data also triangulated with DHIS2 to include unique ids (HDX caveats field, quoted).
meta.vintage: 2016-03-31 (HDX dataset date); last modified on HDX 2019-04-12. Ward set matches the IEBC 2012 delimitation (30 wards, codes 1156-1185).
meta.crs: EPSG:4326 (WGS 84 longitude, latitude; source .prj is GCS_WGS_1984, no reprojection needed)
meta.simplification: shapely coverage_simplify, tolerance 0.0012 degrees, shared edges kept shared; coordinates rounded to 4 decimals. For display only; not for measuring area or distance.
meta.county_bbox_source: Bounds [west, south, east, north] of the six Siaya constituencies in geoBoundaries gbOpen KEN ADM2 (KEN-ADM2-3690345), the layer data/siaya-boundaries.json was drawn from. Projecting this bbox with scripts/make-siaya-map.js gives the extent of that file.

crosscheck.caveat: This dataset is not an official administrative layer from the authorities. Digitized from digital PDF maps by FAO Kenya. Shapefile has no .prj; coordinates are degrees, read as WGS 84.
crosscheck.method: For each ward, the FAO polygon with the largest intersection-over-union with the unsimplified American Red Cross polygon. Not used for geometry.
